attachments.text:
Brands grow — just like companies, products, and people.

When I joined LumApps, I found a company with a great momentum: rapid growth, a bold product vision, a talented international team ready for a new phase.

Now, LumApps is scaling to a new level — and bringing the brand to that ambition. 

Introducing today a refreshed LumApps. More than a new look, it’s a strategic evolution: a brand that reflects the LumApps DNA :dna: and sets the tone for the future.

At the heart of it is our brand idea: The Bright Way to Work.

LumApps is now, more than ever, the future-ready intranet — and the connected employee hub that helps organizations create impactful employee experiences. With the most flexible, scalable, and innovative platform, we connect people to what they need to communicate, take action, and grow — together.

This isn&#39;t a change of direction. It&#39;s a launchpad. To continue leading the way in the Future of Work.

Brand & website projects are always a huge teamwork. First to build a strategy that is both true to a company DNA and compelling for a next phase. Then to develop the creative system and execute across all company touch points. Thank you Elie Mélois Sébastien Ricard & our leadership team that prioritized the strategic work, our design team for creating the visual identity and all Lumies for the execution to bring to life. Thank you for your leadership :yellow_heart:: Jess Ellis, Vanessa Richard, Marie Sargueil, Abby P., Francis N., Blair Williamson. And :pray: Tom Moloney, Rose Rowe and Sofia Megzari for partnering with me yet again and Michael Saifoudine & team – we are lucky to start collaborating.

:sparkles: Want to see it come to life? We’re doing just that with two major events 
:round_pushpin:Chicago, April 29–30. 
:round_pushpin:Paris, June 4–5. 
Register and join us at BRIGHT. Link in comments
